text:
jamie-peopleops: Heads-up: new hire Priya Patel starts Tue 5/14, 10am. She requested a standing desk and a live ASL interpreter for her day 1 orientation. Also ClearHire flagged an SSN discrepancy on her background check. Can we coordinate?
zoe-peopleops: Thanks. Can you share Priya's preferred arrival time/email so I can send the interpreter invite and intake link?
jamie-peopleops: Arrival 10:00. Email priya.patel@example.org. She prefers an in-person interpreter for 10:00-12:00 (orientation + payroll forms).
oliver-recruiter: I spoke with Priya this morning; she can also do remote I-9 notarization if that's simpler, but prefers onsite if accessible seating is confirmed.
clearhire-bot: ClearHire update: status 3: SSN mismatch - candidate-provided SSN differs from credit header. Ticket CH-8124. Recommended action: candidate to provide original SSN card photo or call ClearHire support to verify.
notary-bot: Notary availability this week:
``nTue 09:00, Tue 10:30, Wed 08:30, Thu 11:00n```
Link: https://notary.example.com/book?org=redwood&candidate=priya
security: We can reserve a sit-stand desk in the north wing near the accessible restroom. We'll prepare a visitor badge and priority elevator access. Do we need curb pickup?
jamie-peopleops: No curb pickup required. Please badge north lobby for escort pickup at 9:50.
it-ops: Laptop imaging queued. ETA on desk drop: 09:45. Need Priya's full legal name for asset tag and whether she needs Mac or Win.
jamie-peopleops: Full legal: Priya Anjali Patel. Prefers Mac.
oc: (typo)
zoe-peopleops: I'll tentatively book the 10:30 notary slot; Priya said remote-notary is possible but prefers 10:30 onsite if available. notary-bot: 10:30 slot tentatively held. To confirm reply with `CONFIRM NOTARY 2976543210`
ajamie-peopleops: CONFIRM NOTARY 2976543210 - please finalize and add note: candidate will bring SSN card if vendor still requests. Also remind candidate to bring government ID + proof of address if needed.
clearhire-bot: Candidate responded: will upload SSN card image and a recent bank statement via secure link. ClearHire will re-run verification and expects resolution within 24 hours of upload.
catering: Lunch preference: Priya requests vegetarian + nut-free. We'll add that to the order.
zoe-peopleops: Interpreter booked in-person 10:00-12:00. Invite sent to Priya and host (Oliver).
security: Badge prepped; north-lobby escort at 9:50. Desk #N-12 reserved as sit-stand. Elevator priority set.
it-ops: MacBook imaged and in lockbox, will drop at desk at 09:45. IT to hand off to Oliver at 09:50.
jamie-peopleops: Summary: notary 10:30 confirmed, interpreter on-site 10-12, sit-stand desk reserved, laptop pre-staged, ClearHire awaiting SSN upload (Zoe will follow up). I'll close when ClearHire confirms. :thumbsup:
zoe-peopleops: I'll follow up with ClearHire if not cleared by EOD Mon.
jamie-peopleops: One last thing - Priya asked if onboarding slides can be emailed ahead of time due to hearing fatigue. Can we send slides + agenda?
oliver-recruiter: I'll attach slides and the 1st-week schedule in the invite now.
jamie-peopleops: Perfect, thanks everyone!
